title: LangChain a year ago and today: what the new round changed
intro: Switch between LangChain’s previous funding round, about a year ago, and the round it announced on 13 November. Each side shows only the figures TechCrunch and LangChain published.
note: The round sizes and valuations are from TechCrunch, which describes the earlier round only as about a year ago. The customer count and Workday figure are LangChain’s own and have not been checked independently. TechCrunch did not give a customer count for the earlier round, so that side is left blank rather than filled in.
